doc: Old nodes decode to the cast of their old terms.
name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.termD_extendBy
typeText:
∀ (γ : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance) (es : List.{0} Nat) (ns : List.{0} DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Node)
  (hv : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Valid γ)
  (hv' : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Valid (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.extendBy γ es ns))
  (j : Nat),
  LT.lt.{0} j (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodes γ)) →
    Eq.{1}
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.termD (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.extendBy γ es ns) hv' j)
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.castTm γ es ns (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.termD γ hv j))

source.code:
/-- Old nodes decode to the cast of their old terms. -/
theorem termD_extendBy (hv : γ.Valid) (hv' : (γ.extendBy es ns).Valid) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j < γ.nodes.length) :
    (γ.extendBy es ns).termD hv' j = γ.castTm es ns (γ.termD hv j) := by
  have h := γ.decode_eq_termD hv j hj
  unfold decode at h
  have h' := γ.decodeFuel_extendBy es ns _ j _ h
  have h'' : (γ.extendBy es ns).decode j = some (γ.castTm es ns (γ.termD hv j)) :=
    (γ.extendBy es ns).decodeFuel_le _ _ _ (by rw [extendBy_nodes_length]; omega) _ h'
  simp [termD, h'']
